learning_objective: 🎯 We will capture the joy, bright lights, and wonderful colors of our favorite festivals on paper!

main_concepts.simple_explanation: Festivals are full of bright colors! We can use red, yellow, and orange to draw glowing diyas, fireworks, and beautiful rangolis.
Art is a great way to celebrate! We can fold a paper and draw balloons or cakes on it to make a special card for our friends and family.

fun_activity.title: 🎨 Design a Festive Diya
fun_activity.instructions: Draw a beautiful Diya (lamp) and color it with bright yellow and orange crayons. Add little stars around it to make it shine!

quick_recap: ⭐ Festivals are special days filled with decorations and happiness.
⭐ We use the brightest colors in our crayon box to draw celebrations.
⭐ Homemade art and greeting cards are the best festival gifts!
